svg.aria-label: Scatter plot of large language model intelligence versus API output price on a logarithmic price axis, as of August 7 2026. The mid-price band that Alibaba's Qwen3.8-Max filled on August 3 now has a second entrant: Meta's Muse Spark 1.2, released August 5, at an Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index of 54 for 4.25 dollars per million output tokens. That point sits up and to the left of Qwen3.8-Max at index 53 for 6 dollars, so Muse Spark 1.2 Pareto-dominates it — a higher independent Index at a lower price. Muse Code's contributor tier trades your code for training at about 0.30 dollars per million tokens total, shown as a hollow marker far to the left. The two mid-tier entrants embody opposite strategies: Qwen is a promised open-weights model, Muse Spark 1.2 is a closed, cloud-only API. The cheap floor holds DeepSeek V4-Flash at index 50 for 0.28 dollars and GPT-5.6 Luna at index 51 for 1.20 dollars. The near-frontier open model Kimi K3 sits at index 57 for 15 dollars. The static closed top is led by Claude Opus 5, rescaled to index 63 under Intelligence Index v4.1.1 on August 6, at 25 dollars, still uncut and unanswered.
svg.title: The middle gets contested — Meta's Muse Spark 1.2 (Index 54, $4.25) lands above and left of Qwen3.8-Max (53, $6), Pareto-beating the Chinese entrant two days later; the closed top (Opus 5, rescaled to 63 under Index v4.1.1) stays uncut
svg.text: The middle Qwen filled on Monday got a US answer by Wednesday — and it wins the numbers

Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index (higher = smarter) vs. API output price, log scale. Blue = Muse Spark 1.2 (Meta, closed); violet = Qwen3.8-Max (open-weights pledge); teal = cheap floor; green = open near-frontier; amber/slate/indigo = static top.
THE MID-TIER — now a two-model contest ($4–$6)
API output price per million tokens — log scale (left = cheaper)
Muse Spark 1.2 (Index 54 / $4.25) sits above and left of Qwen3.8-Max (53 / $6): a US closed model beats the new Chinese open-weights-pledge entrant on both Index and price.
Opposite strategies in the same band — Qwen: open weights you self-host (still unshipped); Meta: cheap closed tokens, or a ~$0.30/Mtok "contributor" tier that trades your code for training.
All figures are Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index; v4.1.1 (Aug 6) rescaled absolute scores up a few points but left rankings intact. The closed top has not been cut or answered in ~2 weeks.
